Meta.title: SkillMatch AI
Meta.description: Upload your CV to see the jobs closest to your skills, why each one fits, and what to learn next.
Meta.ogAlt: SkillMatch AI: know what fits, know what to learn next.

Common.tagline: Know what fits. Know what to learn next.
Common.synthetic: Sample data: these jobs and companies are synthetic, not real openings.

Footer.note: MVP prototype. Job listings are synthetic and not real openings.

Landing.title: Find jobs that fit your <mark>skills</mark>
Landing.subtitle: Not sure what to learn first? Upload your CV. AI reads your skills, then shows the closest jobs and which skills to learn next.
Landing.privacy: Your CV is not stored. It only lives in this browser session.
Landing.step1Desc: PDF, up to 5 MB. No CV? Enter your profile yourself.
Landing.step2Desc: Fix any skill we misread and add the ones we missed.
Landing.step3Desc: Your closest jobs, why each scored as it did, and the skills to learn.
Landing.previewLabel: Sample of the results view. Synthetic data, not a real opening.

Upload.title: Upload your CV
Upload.subtitle: AI reads your CV and fills in your profile. You can still correct it before matching.
Upload.privacy: Your CV is not stored. It only lives in this browser session.

error.type: The file must be a PDF.
error.size: The file is larger than 5 MB.
error.extract: We could not read this CV. Try again or enter your profile manually.

Review.title: Review your profile
Review.subtitle: Check what we read from your CV, then add or remove skills.
Review.subtitleManual: Enter your skills to start matching with jobs.
Review.subtitleSample: This is a sample profile. Replace it with your own skills before matching.
Review.name: Name
Review.foundTitle: We found {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}}
Review.skillsHint: These skills are what gets matched against jobs.
Review.detailsHint: Education, experience, and projects help refine the results.
Review.noSkills: Add at least one skill so we can match you.
Review.addSkillHelper: Examples: Python, SQL, Figma. Separate with commas to add several at once.
Review.nameHelper: Optional. Your name is not used for the score.

reason.strong: You already meet {matched} of {total} required skills.
reason.partial: You meet {matched} of {total} required skills. The rest can be learned.
reason.weak: You meet {matched} of {total} skills so far. This job needs a lot of learning.

Match.compact: {skill} points from skills + {text} points from experience and projects
Match.breakdownNote: The score adds two parts: matching skills (up to 60 points) and how similar your education, experience and projects are to the job description (up to 40 points).
Match.addText: Add experience or projects to earn up to 40 points

Results.title: Jobs closest to your profile
Results.subtitle: Top {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}. The score shows how close your profile is, and the skills you do not have yet are your next steps.
Results.few: {count, plural, one {# job is} other {# jobs are}} close enough to your profile. Adding skills opens up more options.
Results.gapHintShared: Several jobs ask for these skills, so learning them opens the most options.
Results.gapHintTop: These are the next steps for {title}, the job closest to your profile.
Results.emptyTitle: No jobs are close enough yet
Results.emptyHint: Try adding skills or completing your experience.
Results.neededIn: asked for in {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}
Results.copied: Learning plan copied. Paste it into your notes or a chat.
Results.copyFailed: Your browser blocked copying. Try again or note the skills above.
Results.planLine: {skill}: asked for in {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}
Results.planNote: Made from synthetic sample job data.

Detail.nextHint: {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} you can learn to get closer to this job.
Detail.allMet: Your profile already meets every required skill. Check the other jobs in your results.
Detail.escoNote: Skill names are matched to the ESCO standard (the EU skills list), so "JS" and "JavaScript" count as the same.
Detail.learnAria: Find learning material for {skill} (opens in a new tab)
